mechanism: Propylthiouracil may increase mexiletine levels through hepatic metabolism inhibition and altered thyroid status affecting drug clearance; propylthiouracil can also cause agranulocytosis increasing infection risk in patients on mexiletine for arrhythmia management.
action: Monitor mexiletine levels and cardiac function closely; consider alternative antithyroid agent if possible; assess for signs of infection and agranulocytosis during concurrent therapy.
